cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Hand It Over
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to give up control of a task, object, or decision you believe is being mishandled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Let me handle the seating plan. You've put the exes together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then they can be civil from separate tables.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me the pencil. I'll preserve the hours and move the chairs.

mechanism: A uses event-seating expertise to persuade B to surrender the pencil, correcting B social assumption while offering a method that preserves B hours of work.
confusable: Ordinary criticism can leave B in control; A must secure the actual decision tool and control of the seating revision.
comparison: Hinge alternative bargains over repair credit; seating alternative protects investment through a copy and minimal changes.
seedUse: Adjacent exes, civil claim, hours and pencil derive from D36-b; S03 adds table-design reasoning and a professional revision method.
